title: Goldman Sachs Limits Claude Code and GitHub AI Access to Engineering Staff
summary:
Personnel in the trading and banking divisions of Goldman Sachs are no longer authorized to use specific artificial intelligence assistants, including the GitHub platform and Anthropic's Claude Code. The firm has limited access to these AI coding tools exclusively to its engineering department.

The bank implemented the restriction to address internal concerns regarding risk and productivity. The move prohibits non-technical staff from utilizing the software in their daily operations while maintaining access for those in technical roles.
